texts.preamble: Viswandhuni Raghu Kumar, vs State Of Andhra Pradesh, on 25 November, 2020 Author: Cheekati Manavendranath Roy Bench: Cheekati Manavendranath Roy The Hon'Ble Sri Justice Cheekati Manavendranath Roy Criminal Petition Nos. 5398, 5401 and 5403 Of 2020 Common Order:
texts.arguments: 2. Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and the learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State. 3. The petitioners have been facing prosecution for the offences punishable under Section 353 IPC and Section 58 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 (for short "FSS Act") in Criminal Petition No.5398 of 2020 and Criminal Petition No.5401 of 2020; Sections 188, 270, 273 IPC, Section 27 of the Cigarettes and Other Tobacco Products (Prohibition of Advertisement and Regulation of Trade and Commerce, Production, Supply and Distribution) Act, 2003 (for short "COTP Act") and under Section 5(1) of the FSS Act in Criminal Petition No.5403 of 2020. 4. Learned counsel for the petitioners would submit that these are covered matters and as per earlier orders passed by this Court, F.I.Rs registered for the similar offences based on identical facts were [LEAKAGE_MASK] by this Court. Therefore, they would pray for quash of the aforesaid charge sheets in the present petitions.
